title_en: Typical Cases of Medical Crimes Published by the Supreme People's Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Publishes Typical Cases of Crimes Against Doctors

Case 1

Wang Yingsheng Intentional Homicide Case

——Killed a Doctor Due to Suspicion of Improper Treatment, Extremely Heinous Crimes

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Wang Yingsheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on December 24, 1950, retired employee.

On October 14, 2012, defendant Wang Yingsheng, suffering from cerebral thrombosis, sought medical treatment at the First Teaching Hospital of Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine. Kang Hongqian (victim, female, died at age 46), chief physician of the acupuncture department of the hospital, performed acupuncture treatment on him. After receiving treatment, Wang Yingsheng felt that his pain had not been alleviated but rather worsened, believing that this was caused by Kang Hongqian's acupuncture, and thus conceived the idea of retaliation. At approximately 1:00 p.m. on November 29 of the same year, Wang Yingsheng carried an axe to the acupuncture consulting room No. 14 on the second floor of the hospital where Kang Hongqian was located, struck Kang Hongqian several times on the head and face with the axe, causing Kang Hongqian's death from severe craniocerebral injury. After committing the crime, Wang Yingsheng jumped from the window of the consulting room, fell to the ground injured, and was subsequently arrested at the scene by public security personnel.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court, and at second instance by Tianjin High People's Court. The Supreme People's Court conducted a death penalty review of this case.

The court found after trial that the defendant Wang Yingsheng intentionally and unlawfully deprived another person of life, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional homicide. Wang Yingsheng groundlessly suspected that his non-improvement was due to improper treatment by the doctor, premeditated assault and retaliation, broke into the hospital with an axe and killed the treating doctor. The means of crime were cruel, the circumstances were vile, and the crimes were extremely heinous, warranting punishment according to law. Accordingly, Wang Yingsheng was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved according to law.

The criminal Wang Yingsheng was executed in accordance with law on April 22, 2014.

Case 2

Wang Yunsheng Intentional Homicide Case

——Killed the Attending Doctor Due to Dissatisfaction with Treatment, Extremely Heinous Crimes

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Wang Yunsheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 5, 1987, farmer.

Defendant Wang Yunsheng, suffering from pulmonary tuberculosis, was hospitalized from July 27, 2011 to August 23, 2011 in the Third People's Hospital of Hengyang, Hunan Province (South District). Upon admission, he was received by Chen Wenming, director of the 12th Ward, and later Chen Yuna (victim, female, died at age 33) served as his attending doctor. During hospitalization, Wang Yunsheng was dissatisfied with the effect of treatment and had multiple disputes with Chen Yuna. After discharge, Wang Yunsheng found that his condition had deteriorated, believing that this was caused by Chen Yuna's stopping, changing, or reducing medication during treatment, thus harboring resentment and deciding to retaliate against Chen Yuna or Chen Wenming. To this end, Wang Yunsheng twice traveled from his workplace in Guangdong Province to Hengyang to await an opportunity for retaliation, but failed to carry it out for various reasons. At approximately 2:00 p.m. on April 28, 2012, Wang Yunsheng carried a pre-prepared folding knife to the hospital, put on a mask, and entered the 12th Ward. Seeing Chen Yuna alone in the doctor's office, he stabbed her in the back with the knife. After being stabbed, Chen Yuna stood up and ran toward the door of the office and fell to the ground. Wang Yunsheng then approached and stabbed her more than 20 times in the neck, chest, back, and other areas, causing Chen Yuna to die from hemorrhagic shock due to carotid artery rupture.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by Hengyang Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province, and at second instance by Hunan High People's Court. The Supreme People's Court conducted a death penalty review of this case.

The court found after trial that the defendant Wang Yunsheng intentionally and unlawfully deprived another person of life, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional homicide. Wang Yunsheng, dissatisfied with the effect of treatment during hospitalization, premeditated retaliation, stabbed the attending doctor more than 20 times with a knife, causing death. The means of crime were cruel, the circumstances were vile, and the crimes were extremely heinous, warranting punishment according to law. Accordingly, Wang Yunsheng was sentenced to death and the death penalty was approved according to law.

The criminal Wang Yunsheng was executed in accordance with law on April 21, 2014.

Case 3

Liu Xiaodong Intentional Injury Case

——Assaulted Doctor Causing Minor Injury Due to Dissatisfaction with Doctor's Recommendation for Transfer

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Liu Xiaodong, male, Han ethnicity, born on July 3, 1968, unemployed.

At approximately 12:30 a.m. on December 3, 2012, defendant Liu Xiaodong, having sustained a head injury, sought medical treatment at Dandong Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Liaoning Province. Liu Xiaodong told the attending doctor Song Feng (victim, male, then aged 46) that he might have a skull fracture. Song Feng recommended that Liu Xiaodong go to another hospital for treatment. Liu Xiaodong was dissatisfied with Song Feng's recommendation for transfer. After leaving for over ten minutes, he returned, tore off Song Feng's glasses, struck Song Feng's mouth and nose with his head, and assaulted Song Feng, causing two of Song Feng's teeth to be broken and a linear fracture of the nasal bone, constituting minor injury.

(2) Judgment

Zhenxing District People's Court of Dandong, Liaoning Province found after trial that the defendant Liu Xiaodong intentionally injured another person's body causing minor injury, and his conduct constituted the crime of intentional injury. Liu Xiaodong, dissatisfied with the doctor's recommendation for transfer during his medical visit, assaulted the doctor causing minor injury, and should be punished according to law. In view of Liu Xiaodong's voluntary confession in court, a lighter punishment could be given as appropriate. Accordingly, Liu Xiaodong was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and four months according to law.

After the first-instance judgment in this case was pronounced, the defendant did not appeal, and the procuratorial authority did not protest. The criminal part of the above judgment became legally effective on December 9, 2013.

Case 4

Bian Jingkui et al. — Crime of Picking Quarrels and Provoking Trouble

——Assaulted Doctors Arbitrarily and Vandalized Property During Medical Visit, Vile Circumstances

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant: Bian Jingkui, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 7, 1992, farmer.

Defendant: Bian Long, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 7, 1986, farmer.

Defendant: Liu Hao, male, Han ethnicity, born on October 15, 1982, farmer.

Defendant: Wang Funan, male, Han ethnicity, born on January 6, 1984, farmer.

Defendant: Song Xiaomeng, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 18, 1985, farmer.

Defendant: Jiang Yu, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 3, 1985, farmer.

On the evening of November 9, 2013, defendants Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Wang Funan, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu drank alcohol together. At approximately 11:00 p.m. that same day, Bian Jingkui, accompanied by the other five persons, went to the Seventh Hospital of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, for treatment of a hand injury. The six persons, including Bian Jingkui, were refused by the on-duty radiologists Wang Chengwei and Qin Pengcheng when they requested an X-ray in violation of medical procedures. They then verbally abused and kicked the door to enter the radiology office, assaulting Wang Chengwei and Qin Pengcheng, causing Wang Chengwei injuries to the head and right upper limb, and Qin Pengcheng lacerations to the right ear, face, and lips. Both injuries were assessed as slight injuries. The six persons, including Bian Jingkui, also caused damage to a medical monitor, a beech wood door, and two wooden stools in the radiology office, with total losses of RMB 4,167.

(2) Judgment

This case was tried at first instance by Zhenhai District People's Court of Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, and at second instance by Ningbo Intermediate People's Court.

The court found after trial that the defendants Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Wang Funan, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu, after drinking alcohol, verbally abused and arbitrarily assaulted the on-duty doctors in the hospital, causing slight injuries to two persons, constituting vile circumstances; they arbitrarily damaged public or private property causing losses of 4,167 yuan, constituting serious circumstances. Their conduct all constituted the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble, and they should be punished according to law. Bian Jingkui, Bian Long, Liu Hao, Song Xiaomeng, and Jiang Yu truthfully confessed to the criminal facts after they were brought to justice and voluntarily admitted guilt, so they should be given lighter punishments according to law; the above five persons actively compensated the victims and the injured unit for economic losses, so they could be given lighter punishments as appropriate. Accordingly, Bian Jingkui and Wang Funan were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of eleven months; Song Xiaomeng and Jiang Yu were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of ten months; and Bian Long and Liu Hao were each sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of nine months according to law.

The above judgments became legally effective on April 16, 2014.
